title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Persons Subject to Evaluation)
(1) Performance and qualification evaluations under Article 35-2 of the Prosecutors' Office Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"; such evaluations hereinafter referred to as "service evaluations") shall be conducted on prosecutors other than prosecutors of the rank of prosecutor of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office or higher under Article 28 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "prosecutors of the rank of prosecutor of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office or higher"). [Amended on November 30, 2018.]
(2) Where the period of service during the relevant service evaluation period is less than three months due to leave of absence or other reasons, no service evaluation shall be conducted. Provided, however, that a service evaluation may be conducted if the Minister of Justice deems it necessary.
(3) Where a prosecutor has served for at least three months during the service evaluation period but there are special grounds determined by the Minister of Justice, including taking a leave of absence under Article 71 (2) 4 of the State Public Officials Act, such prosecutor may be excluded from the assignment of a service evaluation grade, and separate measures determined by the Minister of Justice may be taken. [Newly Inserted on November 30, 2018.]
